source.name: Football Shirt Culture: DR Congo 25/26 Umbro Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the DR Congo crest, the Umbro double-diamond logo and a national flag detail below the neckline, with no commercial sponsor on any placement; the home kit is completed with matching light blue shorts and socks. Footy Headlines (20 Dec 2025) likewise describes the Umbro AFCON kits with no commercial sponsor named.
source.quote: On the chest, the Umbro double diamond logo appears opposite the DR Congo crest, which is positioned on the left side and topped with championship stars.

summary: Umbro home kit for the 2025 AFCON, still the current strip in 2026. No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the FECOFA crest, Umbro branding and a national-flag chest detail, with matching sponsor-free shorts and socks. DR Congo's Umbro contract runs to late 2026 (Footy Headlines).
